overview_description.description:
Founded in 2000, Anchor is a leading provider of AWS and cloud hosting services. While their primary responsibility is to ensure your business-critical production web applications are fully operational, secure and performing at their best, the approach they take to achieving this is different to most of their competitors.

The days of development and operations teams working in isolation are over. In today’s fast-paced, DevOps-driven world of software development, code is deployed into production at an incredible rate – often up to 20 times a day. As Agile development enters this new era, the ability of your Cloud Ops partner to support & empower your developers — working together tightly throughout the development process – is essential to the success of your application.

Anchor can help your business realise the benefits of elastic computing & infrastructure automation. They will assist your dev team to build and maintain a scalable, reliable, secure and cost-effective application, providing your business with increased agility and a platform from which you’ll be able to grow and satisfy more customers.

They deliver AWS infrastructure design, provisioning, management, security, performance, cost optimisation and system administration services, all wrapped up in a flexible pay-as-you-go business model. And if you’re working to modernise your development processes, they can also help accelerate your DevOps, CI & CD journey; embedding staff with application architecture, operations & AWS automation expertise within your team on a consulting basis.
